findings.title: Exercise single-use recovery codes in the federated-storage test
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator returns true for any matching code without consuming it or persisting updated state. Its getCredentials() method also reconstructs a fresh, unused recovery-code model on every call. Consequently, the test provider accepts the same code indefinitely, always requests code 0, and never exercises the authenticator's exhaustion/re-enrollment path. The new integration test stops after one login, so it passes despite this broken recovery-code lifecycle. Make the provider track consumed codes and extend the test to verify replay rejection, advancement to the next code, and re-enrollment after exhaustion.
